text: @lijian-ui/dsh-term 是供 DSH Web GUI 使用的本机终端插件，在网页右侧加入可收起的终端面板，并通过宿主 PTY 服务启动真实 shell。它支持多标签终端、Bash、Zsh、PowerShell、命令提示符和 Git Bash 等可用 shell，能调整终端大小、分离仍在运行的会话并重新接回，也可将选中的终端文本加入当前对话草稿。适合需要在 DSH 工作区旁运行本机命令并管理多个 shell 会话的用户。使用需要本机 shell 和 DSH Web 宿主，无需额外 API 密钥。

@lijian-ui/dsh-term adds a local terminal panel to the DSH Web GUI. It supports multiple PTY tabs, shell selection, resizing, detaching and reattaching sessions, and adding selected output to the conversation draft. Requires a local shell and DSH web host; no API key.

Can I keep a command running after closing its terminal tab and reopen it later?
I need several local shell sessions in the DSH web interface.
@lijian-ui/dsh-term 的功能「多标签本机终端」：在 DSH 网页右侧面板创建多个 PTY shell 标签，可输入命令并查看实时输出。
@lijian-ui/dsh-term 的功能「选择 Shell」：面板检测本机可用的 shell 并提供选择，创建会话时可使用 Bash、Zsh、PowerShell、cmd 或 Git Bash。
@lijian-ui/dsh-term 的功能「后台保留会话」：关闭标签会分离而不终止 PTY；用户可从后台会话列表重新接回，或主动结束该会话。
@lijian-ui/dsh-term 的功能「终端选区加入对话」：选中终端输出后点击浮动按钮，所选文字会追加到当前会话的输入草稿。

@lijian-ui/dsh-term README · @lijian-ui/dsh-term：Panel-style local terminal for the DSH web GUI.

- **Real PTY sessions** via [`node-pty`](https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty) — a genuine local shell, not a curated command runner.
- **Multi-tab terminal panel** built on [xterm.js](https://xtermjs.org/), docked in the right-side panel (alongside `@lijian-ui/dsh-file-manager`).
- **Workspace cwd** — each session starts in the current workspace root.
- **Hot-pluggable** — loaded as a profile bundle; no changes to DSH source are required.
@lijian-ui/dsh-term README · @lijian-ui/dsh-term：> This is the **A edition**: local user terminal only. A planned **B edition** adds SSH connections and per-session shell selection.

@lijian-ui/dsh-term README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add @lijian-ui/dsh-term
```

Or add `@lijian-ui/dsh-term` to your profile's `bundles` / `dependencies` and reference it from `cordis.yml`.

@lijian-ui/dsh-term README · Behavior：- Default state is **collapsed** (closed). Open it from the right-side panel launcher (the "终端" button) — it docks as the rightmost column next to the file-manager panel.
- Sessions are managed by a host-side service (`src/host/pty-service.ts`) exposed over loopback-only HTTP + SSE routes (`src/host/routes.ts`). The client renders them with xterm.js and syncs resize/input.
